purpose: Local evaluation with frozen GeoBenchX inputs. No raw dataset redistribution.

density.attribution: WorldPop and CIESIN. Algeria population density 2020, UN adjusted, 1 km. DOI 10.5258/SOTON/WP00675.
density.finding: Archive citation identifies the UN-adjusted density edition and CC4.0international. WorldPop declares CC BY 4.0; its companion Algeria density product documents people/km² units. Preserve original UNadj bytes, not the companion unadjusted file.

counties.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau. TIGER/Line 2024 county boundaries.
counties.finding: Census identifies TIGER as a public-domain geospatial source. Pinned archive citation and file identify the 2024 edition.

earthquakes.attribution: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program. Frozen GeoBenchX 30-day earthquake snapshot labelled Feb142025.
earthquakes.finding: USGS-authored data are public domain; retain source attribution. The actual frozen file contains January 16–February 15, 2025 UTC event timestamps.

stations.attribution: Amtrak / USDOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Amtrak Stations, frozen GeoBenchX snapshot.
stations.finding: Official DOT catalog declares CC0-1.0. Use only the already supplied historical archive, not the current 2026 dataset; preserve attribution and source metadata.
